title: Figures 83-84: CFD pressure and temperature around Tic Tac UAP at 1100 mph supersonic
description: Two CFD contour plots of the Tic Tac UAP at 1/6 scale, 223K and 1100 mph with supersonic inlet and supersonic outlet. Figure 83 shows the pressure field (Pa) with a detached bow shock; Figure 84 shows the temperature field (K) with a hot orange wake. Supersonic case in the BAASS aerodynamic analysis.
